verdict.rationale: SerpApi's integrations docs say its MCP integration lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) use SerpApi as a web search tool, and a probe confirms an official MCP server in the first-party serpapi/serpapi-mcp GitHub repo. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed tools, auth and setup (hosted vs. local), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
